tactics: have key : ∀ l1 l2 (s : l1.Sublist l2), List.Sublist.below (motive := motive) s ∧ motive l1 l2 s := by intro l1 l2 s; induction s <;> refine (fun h => ⟨h, F _ _ _ h⟩) ?_ <;> constructor <;> simp_all

have key : ∀ l1 l2 (s : l1.Sublist l2), List.Sublist.below (motive := motive) s ∧ motive l1 l2 s := by intro l1 l2 s; induction s <;> exact (fun h => ⟨h, F _ _ _ h⟩) (by constructor <;> first | assumption | exact (by assumption : _ ∧ _).1 | exact (by assumption : _ ∧ _).2)

have key : ∀ l1 l2 (s : l1.Sublist l2), List.Sublist.below (motive := motive) s ∧ motive l1 l2 s := by intro l1 l2 s; induction s with | slnil => exact ⟨by constructor, F _ _ _ (by constructor)⟩ | cons a s ih => exact ⟨by constructor <;> simp_all, F _ _ _ (by constructor <;> simp_all)⟩ | cons₂ a s ih => exact ⟨by constructor <;> simp_all, F _ _ _ (by constructor <;> simp_all)⟩
